definition: 1. An area served by a particular church; an ecclesiastical district. 2. In the U.S. state of Louisiana, a government sub-unit; the equivalent of a county. It administers the governance of a portion of the state and part of the state power are delegated to the parish. See State ex rel. Centani v. Marrero. As parenthetical / parish Dictionary compilation | 26 September 2026 delegated bodies of the state, the Louisiana constitution provides that the state legislature may dissolve, alter the boundaries of, or create new parishes. LA State Constitution Art. VI § 1. The term derives from Louisiana’s Spanish and French history, when it was Roman Catholic.
